title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Time To Move. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Time To Move
options.lineage: relay baton handoffs and the club's own crest of three reaching figures
options.thesis: The club as a launcher of trajectories: every proof point is drawn mid-rise.
options.viewport: Full-bleed blue field; TIME TO MOVE at display scale over a bank of rising proof counters (370+ teams, 65+ universities, est. 2018), Partner and Join actions, partner-name strip at the base.
options.risk: Momentum can tip into sportswear energy; the proof counters and document-precision type hold the line.

raised.raise: Signals drawn onto the surface: the blue field floods whatever is live — open applications, current events, the primary action — color as a signal, never decoration.
Strict palette law: sky blue owns the ground; magenta is reserved for the energy moment and gold for the achievement moment, each appearing once per viewport.
Asymmetry as compositional law: every viewport is deliberately off-axis with momentum rising left-to-right; no centered template anywhere.

options.label: The Business Desk
options.lineage: Bangladeshi business broadsheets — The Business Standard is a signed partner
options.thesis: Every club achievement printed as the day's business edition, sourced like news.
options.viewport: A dated broadsheet front page: masthead JKKNIU-SDC DESK, the lead story set on BizCase's 370+ teams, partner names as bylines, Membership as the subscription box.
options.risk: Also the direction most institutional club sites land on.

options.label: Nixie Counter Bank
options.thesis: The club's record rendered as physical lit counters: every stat has depth.
options.viewport: A dark instrument panel where 370+ TEAMS, 65+ UNIVERSITIES, 1 LAKH BDT burn as digit tubes; the Partner action sits as an engraved panel button.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity — real stats as lit counters is the proof story; loses on audience identification with a Dhaka campus audience.
options.risk: Retro-industrial costume fights the sky-blue brand unless the digits carry brand color.

options.label: Title Card Session
options.thesis: Each club program freezes as a title card against its own flooded color field.
options.viewport: BizCase as EP.07 title card: giant colliding caps over a flooded blue field, event list as a numbered index strip, Join as a stamped bar.
options.case: Holds audience identification — student energy at full volume; loses narrowly on clarity when display caps collide.
options.risk: Freeze-frame cuts can bury the offer; the CTA must survive the collision.

options.label: Living Skin
options.viewport: A cream surface whose pigment cells flood with brand color as signals.
options.case: Fuses poorly: an ocean-biology costume for a Dhaka university club hides the offer.
options.kept: Signals drawn directly onto the surface.
options.risk: Reads as a marine-biology demo, not a university club.

options.label: Raku Firing
options.viewport: Soot-black vessel ground with crackled glaze panels and one ember-hot active item.
options.case: Fuses poorly: smoke and ceramic craft carry no club meaning and fight the daylight campus scene.
options.kept: One hot field reserved by law for the live item.
options.risk: Ceremonial gloom where the site needs credibility in daylight.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.viewport: A pixel-grid playfield where club achievements light up as sprite states.
options.case: Fuses poorly: gamification is the anti-goal and the costume drowns the offer.
options.kept: Palette discipline — one flash color reserved by law for power moments.
options.risk: Reads as a game, not an institutional pipeline.

options.label: Rental Wall
options.viewport: Club programs as face-out clamshell spines browsed by aisle.
options.case: Fuses poorly: browsing nostalgia maps to nothing the club must prove.
options.kept: Absence made visible — the empty slot with a tag.
options.risk: Western retro costume for a Bangladeshi campus.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a university club site ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Hero headline over stats and event cards, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other club site by design.
